summary: Flathead NF platform lookout site in Flathead County, MT, dated to the 1930s; listed abandoned, not gone. Panoramas taken there 7 Sept 1935. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: platform tower with a camp, 1930s, per firelookout.com
facts.status_note: Listed abandoned by firelookout.com and the Forest Fire Lookout Association. No source describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

corrections.why: The Forest Fire Lookout Association row for Wedge Mountain reads Platform Abandoned, and firelookout.com also says Abandoned. Neither source says gone.

sources.title: History of the Panoramic Lookout Project

notes_for_editor: Record status 'gone' is wrong against its own FFLA source (Platform Abandoned) and firelookout.com (Abandoned); corrected to abandoned here for human review. Kind 'platform' and coordinates match. The 1935 panorama date agrees across the Forest Lookouts county page and two NPS rows; the Forest Lookouts entry is read as belonging to Wedge Mountain from the page layout. The NPS table files Wedge Mt. under its Glacier National Park section while the lookout sits in the Flathead National Forest; the story does not claim a park location. The 1930s date for the platform is firelookout.com's, with no year given. No source describes what remains today, access, or any photo; none found.
